The document is a Distribution and Development Agreement between Sekisui Diagnostics, LLC and Qualigen, Inc., dated May 1, 2016. The agreement establishes an exclusive distribution relationship for the Territory (worldwide excluding retained customers) with a five-year initial term. Key obligations include exclusivity, supply commitments, financing payments, IP ownership, audit rights, insurance requirements, and specific termination rights. A Sale Transaction definition triggers change-of-control-like provisions including an Exclusivity Period, Negotiation Period, and Right of First Refusal.

The document is Chunk 2 of a Distribution and Development Agreement between Sekisui Diagnostics, LLC and Qualigen, Inc. It contains Sections 13 through 15 (Miscellaneous), Exhibits A-F, and Schedule 2.1. Key obligations extracted include audit rights, assignment restrictions, use of names, press releases, and third-party beneficiary disclaimers. Termination clauses are found in Section 14. Governing law is Delaware. No explicit effective date or contract value is stated in this chunk.

This is Chunk 1 of a 4-chunk Co-Development Agreement between PhaseBio Pharmaceuticals Inc. and SFJ Pharmaceuticals X, Ltd. The chunk contains the Preamble, Article 1 (Definitions), and Articles 2 and 3 (Clinical Trials). I have scanned for all family clauses defined in the instructions. Key findings include: Change of Control definition (Section 1.1.25), Exclusivity/Non-compete via Exclusive Period (Section 1.1.68), IP Ownership/Acknowledgment of Background Materials (Section 2.5.1.1), Audit Rights (Section 3.6), and various operational duties that are NOT family clauses (e.g., clinical trial conduct, reporting, compliance). No termination, renewal, governing law, or contract value clauses are present in this chunk.

This chunk (2 of 4) contains the operational, governance, and financial sections of a collaboration agreement between PhaseBio Pharmaceuticals Inc. ('PB') and Sanofi Japan K.K. ('SFJ'). It covers clinical trial conduct, audits, regulatory efforts, exclusivity commitments, development cost funding schedules, security interests, and payment obligations for regulatory approvals. Key family clauses identified include Exclusivity (Section 3.19), License Grant/Exclusivity nuances (Section 3.14.2.1), Minimum Commitment/Cost Caps (Section 4.2.1, 4.2.2, 4.2.3), Revenue/Profit Sharing (Approval Payments in Section 6.1), Price Restrictions (Cost caps in Section 4.2), Audit Rights (Section 3.6), Change of Control Buy-Out (Section 6.7.2), and Anti-Assignment restrictions within the Security Interest section (Section 7.5.6).

This chunk (3 of 4) contains the latter half of a development and commercialization agreement between PhaseBio Pharmaceuticals Inc. ('PB') and Sanofi (formerly Aventis/Sanofi Genzyme, referred to as 'SFJ'). It covers IP ownership assignments, insurance requirements, indemnification, representations, and the comprehensive Term and Termination provisions. Key obligations extracted include IP assignment duties, specific insurance maintenance, and various termination rights with associated payment consequences.

This chunk (4 of 4) contains the tail end of Section 14 (Termination), Article 15 (Miscellaneous), and signature pages. Key obligations extracted include IP assignment upon termination, post-termination clinical trial wind-down/transfer duties, assignment restrictions with specific carve-outs for affiliates and successors, limitation of liability (consequential damages waiver), non-solicitation of employees, and third-party beneficiary disclaimers. Governing law is Delaware. Effective date is January 9, 2020.
